# Report: the stack and architecture as built

Date: 2026-10-31. A read-only investigation for the architecture slide. Every finding names the file
it comes from. Versions come from `apps/pwa/package-lock.json` (web) and `requirements.lock`
(Python); where a package is not in `requirements.lock`, the version installed in `.venv` is given
and marked so. No paid or external API was called. Environment variables are listed by name only.

Status words: **Built**, **Partly built**, **Planned, not built** (described in docs or prompts,
no code), **Not found**.

Two repo-level notes first:

- `requirements.lock` is out of date: it lacks `weasyprint`, `fonttools`, `pypdfium2`,
  `google-cloud-firestore` and `psycopg`, which `pyproject.toml` lists (main or optional groups).
- `apps/pwa-v2/` is an untracked copy of the web app (`git status`: `?? apps/pwa-v2/`, its
  `package.json` has the same name). This report covers `apps/pwa/`, which the build, CI and docs use.

## Replacement text for the architecture slide

**On the phone**
- React 19 + Vite web app, installable (PWA): the service worker keeps every screen working offline after the first visit
- IndexedDB (Dexie) holds checks, rehearsal transcripts and an offline outbox; class counts sync when online
- Camera capture with on-phone photo shrink (~1200 px JPEG)
- The error finder runs on the phone from engine-made answer keys
- Practice Class voice: recorded on the phone, turned into text on the server

**Backend API**
- Python 3.12 + FastAPI
- Paper Studio: versioned rules, seeded generator, independent verifier, WeasyPrint PDFs
- Sheet reading (call 8), error finder, cohort and mentor rules, one track per class by rule
- Verdict statistics (bootstrap, exact McNemar)
- Practice Class simulator (seeded, rule-based); simulated block of classes
- Role-based assistant; tester stats; judge demo flow
- Guardrails: name masking, validators, pre-filter, checker call, coach approval
- Next-step policy (planned); Bayesian child model (planned)

**AI and voice**
- Claude API: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus by call; structured outputs, prompt caching, vision for sheets, Message Batches for offline drafting
- Sarvam: Saaras speech-to-text, Bulbul voice
- Gemini embeddings for the assistant's search (optional)

**Data**
- SQLAlchemy 2: SQLite in development, Cloud SQL Postgres 16 in production; tables created at start (migrations planned)
- Vector search in Firestore for the assistant (optional)
- Private Google Cloud Storage buckets: pilot sheet photos, published lesson audio
- Rules and content as YAML (`rules/`, `content/`); knowledge as Markdown (`docs/help/`)

**Checks and hosting**
- pytest (2,356 tests), Vitest (428), Playwright (182), axe on the Paper Studio, check and demo screens
- Evaluation harness: engine items, simulator fidelity, red team, statistics, assistant
- GitHub Actions CI with a secret scan
- Google Cloud Run, asia-south1 (Mumbai), for the API and the web app
